title: Parameter-Dependent Noise Resilience in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
summary: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a variational quantum algorithm used for solving combinatorial optimization problems, which is thought to be a promising application of near-term quantum hardware. However, high rates of noise in these devices can obscure meaningful results. Therefore, it is crucial to understand and suppress the effects of noise on the algorithm's output.
